## 275_R6WEB.1 — web-hardening cluster (RH-30/31/23/32/33/34)

Six verified findings from the operator handoff, each fixed with a regression that failed pre-fix:

- **RH-30** — CSP nonce is stamped author-side (`csp.ts` ALS + `NonceScript` in `@rhema/ui` + builder stamping in `render.tsx`/`spa-shell.ts`); the whole-body `<script>` regex pass is deleted, so markup the server did not author can no longer inherit a working nonce.
- **RH-23** — web-host mutation guard: `Origin` must equal the request origin, else `Sec-Fetch-Site` ≠ `cross-site`, else `403 forbidden_origin` (mirrors the api's guard; server-side `apiFetch` unaffected).
- **RH-31** — magic-link emails now point at the no-consume interstitial `GET /auth/magic-link`; the confirm click POSTs and the web relays the verify server-side (token consumed only on click — mail-scanner prefetch can no longer burn links). Journeys updated (matcher + confirm click).
- **RH-32** — `acquisition_events.ip_hash` is a keyed, daily-rotating HMAC over the LB-appended (penultimate) XFF hop — no more unsalted sha256 of the client-controlled first hop; stored rows untouched.
- **RH-33** — `next` judged by resolved `url.origin` (`sameOriginPath` in contracts); `/\evil.example` refused at `beginAuth` and the login gate.
- **RH-34** — every session gate's `/login` redirect carries a validated `?next=` deep link; LoginPage round-trips it as a hidden field into `beginAuth` → callbackURL.

**Verify:** turbo build 29/29 · typecheck+lint clean on 5 pkgs · focused suites green (web-hardening 15, server.test 120, demo 37, magic-link-email 11, showcase 11) · dom-contract OK · spend $0.
